title: Xdrip changes lock screen wallpaper
body:
I am using the samsung galaxy A50 currently and xdrip keeps changing the wallpaper to black with my current BG on the top left (see attached screenshot for more details) and I am wondering if this is a bug or if there is a way to fix it / turn it off.
![Screenshot_20191213-175916_Google 1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53744293/70814288-d78f0200-1dd3-11ea-9acf-e5c4122e9294.jpg)

comments.body:
You can disable this in:
xDrip+ Display Settings > Number Wall on Lock Screen -> Use on Lock screen (OFF)

Also, you can keep it enabled and configure the wallpaper in "Configure Number Wall"
Are you using with DexCom G6?
@kaloyansarafov Is the problem solved? If yes, please close this issue?
